+import numpy as np
+import mujoco
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+import casa_tool
+
+s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
+m, d = s.model, s.data
+site_id = s.env.robots[0].eef_site_id['right']
+jids = [m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').id for i in range(1, 8)]
+qids = [m.jnt_qposadr[j] for j in jids]
+vids = [m.jnt_dofadr[j] for j in jids]
+qlim = m.jnt_range[jids].copy()
+scratch = mujoco.MjData(m)
+R0 = d.site_xmat[site_id].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+
+def pose(q):
+    scratch.qpos[:] = d.qpos
+    scratch.qpos[qids] = q
+    mujoco.mj_forward(m, scratch)
+    return scratch.site_xpos[site_id].copy(), scratch.site_xmat[site_id].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+
+def solve(p, R=R0, q0=None):
+    q = d.qpos[qids].copy() if q0 is None else np.array(q0, float).copy()
+    for k in range(130):
+        x, r = pose(q)
+        er = Rotation.from_matrix(R @ r.T).as_rotvec()
+        err = np.r_[p-x, er * 0.35]
+        if np.linalg.norm(p-x) < .002 and np.linalg.norm(er) < .04:
+            break
+        jp = np.zeros((3, m.nv)); jr = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
+        mujoco.mj_jacSite(m, scratch, jp, jr, site_id)
+        J = np.vstack((jp[:, vids], jr[:, vids] * 0.35))
+        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + .005 * np.eye(6), err)
+        q = np.clip(q + np.clip(dq, -.12, .12), qlim[:,0]+.01, qlim[:,1]-.01)
+    x, r = pose(q)
+    print('IK', np.round(p,3), 'actual', np.round(x,3), 'err', round(np.linalg.norm(p-x),3), 'q', np.round(q,2), flush=True)
+    return q
+
+def cmd(q=None, grip=-1, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1):
+    a = s.hold_targets()
+    if q is not None: a[:7] = q
+    a[7] = grip
+    a[8:11] = base
+    a[11] = torso
+    a[12] = mode
+    s.step(a)
+
+def run(q, n, grip=-1, label=''):
+    for i in range(n): cmd(q, grip)
+    print(label, 'step',len(s.actions),'eef',np.round(d.site_xpos[site_id],3),'cup',np.round(d.body(s.env.obj_body_id['stackable']).xpos,3),'ket',np.round(d.body(s.env.obj_body_id['receptacle']).xpos,3),'success',s.check()['success'], flush=True)
+
+cup = d.body(s.env.obj_body_id['stackable']).xpos.copy()

+run(solve(np.array([cup[0], cup[1], 1.005])), 55, label='at cup')
